title.zh: 分支测试下的目标唯一性

claim.zh: 若目标模型由分支测试分离，与同一源位置有相同测试真值的两个目标位置相等。
claim.en: If branching tests separate the target model, two target positions agreeing with one source position on all tests are equal.

hypotheses.zh: ExplanatoryBranching 的 Model、Test、Same；目标满足 Separated。
hypotheses.en: ExplanatoryBranching Model, Test and Same; Separated holds for the target.

correspondence.zh: 测试包括条件、否定、合取和动作后继；测试适用性是解释范围的一部分。
correspondence.en: Tests include conditions, negation, conjunction and action successors; their applicability is part of explanatory scope.

detail.zh: 声明形似，但测试与模型不同；未断言这两个引理相互转换。
detail.en: Similar header, different tests and models; no adapter between these lemmas is asserted.

detail.zh: Alike.functional：相同分离一个框架的配置时，一个配置至多与其中一个相同；配置的同一读作相同时（Ren 同意这一方向），这就是那种同一。
detail.en: Alike.functional: where likeness tells a frame's configurations apart, a configuration is alike to at most one of them; with the identity of configurations read as likeness (Ren agreed with the direction), this is that identity.

detail.zh: 这个小引理本身不要求 image-finiteness，也不独自证明普遍双模拟或唯一本体。
detail.en: This lemma itself needs no image-finiteness and does not alone establish universal bisimulation or unique ontology.

limitations.zh: 这个小引理本身不要求 image-finiteness，也不独自证明普遍双模拟或唯一本体。
limitations.en: This lemma itself needs no image-finiteness and does not alone establish universal bisimulation or unique ontology.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 使用这一测试语言时复用；更丰富语言需保留其本地语义。
next_delta.en: Reuse for this test language; a richer language must retain its own semantics.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I1：在脊柱上陈述。检验分离一个模型，恰当核心的分支检验分离其框架（separated_iff），所以本引理经 sameBranchingTests_iff_same 即 SameBranchingTests.functional；其相同之下的形式为 Alike.functional。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围；脊柱运行 20261014T100026.593496Z 亦将其源码作为继承模块编译并绑定。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I1: stated on the spine. Tests separate a model exactly where the core's branching tests separate its frame (separated_iff), so this lemma is SameBranchingTests.functional read through sameBranchingTests_iff_same; its form for likeness is Alike.functional. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope; the spine run 20261014T100026.593496Z also compiles its source as an inherited module and binds it.

14 October 2026, batch 5 of the open-issues plan (landing integration I1): the spine modules Becoming.Likeness, Becoming.Bridge are bound to core receipt 20261014T141427.442103Z, which elaborates the new spine alias.
history.zh: 2026年10月14日，开放问题计划第五批（整合 I1 落地）：脊柱模块 Becoming.Likeness、Becoming.Bridge 绑定到核心回执 20261014T141427.442103Z，该回执展开新的脊柱别名。

2026年10月14日，整合 I3a 落地（开放问题计划 I 列；研究第124节）：改绑新回执并更新哈希：Bridge.lean（整合 I3a：七个外围族的实例节（RelationalGrounding、ProtectionPriorityRival、ChanceAdequacy、FallibleInspection、BecomingReversibility、DynamicConsequences、DerivedHistoryLaw）；原有陈述不变）。
history.en: 14 October 2026, landing integration I3a (open-issues plan, stream I; study section 124): rebound to the new receipts and rehashed: Bridge.lean (integration I3a: instance sections for seven periphery families (RelationalGrounding, ProtectionPriorityRival, ChanceAdequacy, FallibleInspection, BecomingReversibility, DynamicConsequences, DerivedHistoryLaw); earlier statements unchanged).
